neighbours.label: a hard line break in the middle of a running sentence (the text continues on the next line), as against the same sentence unbroken or a break between sentences
fire:
The committee agreed that the town must
build a new bridge before winter.

Nobody could explain why
the birds left the island so early.

It was obvious,
however, that the plan would cost too much.

She had finished her tea and
was reading the letter a second time.

Every member of the crew should
report to the deck at noon.

Doctors still do not know why
the fever returns each spring.

The rain had stopped and
was replaced by a cold wind from the north.

Once more the farmers must
wait for the river to fall.
quiet: The committee agreed the town must build a new bridge before winter.
Nobody could explain why the birds had left the island so early.
It was obvious, however, that the scheme would cost too much.

She had finished her tea.
The letter lay open on the table.
Each member of the crew should report to the deck at noon.
Doctors still cannot say why the fever returns each spring.

The rain had stopped.
A cold wind came from the north.
Once more the farmers must wait for the river to go down.
